g.text: Send a Friend Request — search, validation and persistence
Search: case-insensitive username substring; exclude sender.
[Search / revise until recipient selected or sender cancels]
[Self, already friends, or outgoing pending request]
Reject with reason; no new request
Return existing incoming request; do not send another
Show incoming request with Accept / Decline
End send goal; handling incoming request is separate.
Store pending request; enforce one per account pair
Confirm stored and available to recipient
Sending alone never creates friendship; acceptance/decline is separate.
Self is rejected by the service even though search excludes sender.
A missing response is not a confirmed rejection or save failure.
Without confirmation the client must not claim success; recovery is unresolved.
